info.title: Machine frontend integration contract
info.description: Runtime schemas for the Machine gateway. OVH implements chat, wallet ownership, mandates, live observations, comparisons and routines. Nile jTRX supply and redemption have verified signed transaction receipts. Portfolio reviews compare holding and adjustments with current state and costs, and persist account notifications. A new performance period requires closed Nile positions and reconciled transactions; historical receipts and policy spending remain intact. USDD execution adapters exist but have not completed a mainnet live lifecycle. Workspace identity is derived from the session.
